items.title: Python support
items.body:
Today Python projects only get file counts, Makefile/justfile targets, CI and the generic
checks. Bring Python to the level of the JavaScript and Go support, as a series of PRs:
start with detection, add routes after.

**Scope**
- Package managers and lockfiles: uv (`uv.lock`), Poetry, Pipenv, pip (`requirements*.txt`)
- Runtime version: `.python-version`, `requires-python`, `.tool-versions`
- Frameworks: Django, Flask, FastAPI
- Routes: FastAPI/Flask decorators, Django `urls.py`
- Environment v

items.title: Support Python 3.14
items.body:
### Context

`requires-python = ">=3.12,<3.14"` in `pyproject.toml` rules out Python 3.14, so `pip install meridian-eval` refuses to install on it.

### What to do

Lift the upper bound, add 3.14 to the CI matrix in `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (the `static` job already runs 3.12 and 3.13), and fix whatever breaks.

### Done when

CI is green on 3.12, 3.13 and 3.14, and the PyPI classifiers list 3.14.

### Where to look

`pyproject.toml`, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
